violations.description: Untrusted event data used in runs-on expression allowing arbitrary code execution on runner pool
violations.recommendation: Use a static runner label (e.g. ubuntu-latest) instead of evaluating untrusted event properties for runs-on.

violations.description: Secret echoed directly to GitHub Actions workflow log
violations.recommendation: Do not echo secrets or secret-derived environment variables into the step logs.

violations.description: Vulnerable substring check on github.actor allowing allowlist bypass
violations.recommendation: Compare github.actor against an explicit array or list of exact usernames rather than using substring contains().

violations.description: Untrusted github.event expression interpolated directly into shell script
violations.recommendation: Pass the untrusted event data into the step via an environment variable instead of direct interpolation.

violations.description: Verbose HTTP client logging prints sensitive authorization token header to logs
violations.recommendation: Remove the -v (verbose) flag from curl when sending requests containing authorization tokens or sensitive headers.
